dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL free-format source indicated by '$set sourceformat"free"' compiler directive; student exercise likely compiled with GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: University/course exercise (lista8 = list 8, exercise 2) involving date input validation and a simple login/authentication screen
purpose.summary: A student exercise program that displays a TUI screen accepting year/month/day date fields along with user-id and password. It validates that fields are filled, calls an external subprogram 'programa02' for authentication, and handles access-granted/denied messages. The program uses a structured section layout with initialization, processing, and finalization sections.

notable_features: Stray non-COBOL text at end of source ('O ano <ano> nao eh bissexto e eh par.')
References to undeclared working-storage variables (wk-user-id, wk-password, wk-msn, wk-sair, etc.)
verdict.notes: The file contains a stray Portuguese-language sentence at the very end of the PROCEDURE DIVISION ('O ano <ano> nao eh bissexto e eh par.') which is syntactically invalid COBOL and appears to be a leftover comment or copy-paste artifact. Several variables referenced in the PROCEDURE DIVISION (wk-user-id, wk-password, wk-msn, wk-sair, wk-limite-tentativas, wk-acesso-liberado, wk-cont-tentativa, wk-tela-aut-senha, wk-senha-incorreta, wk-usuario-incorreto, wk-menu) are not declared in the DATA DIVISION shown, suggesting the file is incomplete or relies on a copybook not included. Decoded as latin-1 due to accented Portuguese characters.
